description:
These flat rectangular khaprail tiles are natural fired clay roof tiles with a straight, flat profile, made by Pak Clay in Lahore for a clean, modern roofline on new builds and restoration work.

## How they look
A plain rectangle with straight edges, laid in overlapping courses, gives a roof neat horizontal lines rather than the waves of Spanish or Roman profiles. That makes flat khaprail roof tiles a good fit for contemporary houses, while the natural clay colour keeps a traditional warmth. Natural clay tends to vary slightly in shade from tile to tile.

## Where they work
- **Modern houses** with pitched roofs, where modern clay roof tiles suit clean architecture.
- **Restoration work** on older buildings with flat-tile roofs.
- **Porches, sheds and gazebos**, where a plain clay roof tile keeps the look simple.

Fired clay generally holds its colour without paint, and a ventilated pitched clay roof can help keep heat off the slab below.

## Good to know
- Material: natural fired clay
- Profile: flat rectangular
- Category: khaprail roof tiles
- Size, coverage per square foot and weight: confirm on enquiry

Flat tiles rely on overlap and pitch to keep rain out, so have your roofer or engineer confirm the slope, battens and underlay. Our guide on [clay vs concrete roof tiles](/blog/clay-vs-concrete-roof-tiles-in-pakistan-which-is-better) covers how clay compares.

## See it before you order
Pak Clay shows its range at the Lahore head office on Walton Road (opposite Packages Mall Gate 2) and at G-04 Civic Center, Executive Block, Gulberg Greens, Islamabad, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm. Ask for a [free sample on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/923004617715) to see the finish, then send your roof area and city for a dated quote. Compare the [flat half circle khaprail tile](/products/flat-half-circle-khaprail-tiles) or browse all [khaprail tiles](/categories/khaprail-tiles).

faqs.q: What is the price of flat rectangular khaprail tiles in Pakistan?
faqs.a: Pak Clay does not publish a fixed rate online. The price depends on the quantity, the area to cover and delivery to your city, so send your measurements on WhatsApp (+92 300 4617715) for a dated written quote.

faqs.q: Are flat khaprail tiles suitable for a modern house?
faqs.a: Yes. The straight profile gives neat horizontal lines that tend to suit contemporary designs better than curved Spanish or Roman tiles, while keeping a natural clay colour.

faqs.q: Flat clay tiles or concrete roof tiles: which is better?
faqs.a: Clay generally keeps its colour without paint and is the traditional choice in Pakistan; concrete tiles are often heavier and may need recoating over time. Our clay vs concrete guide compares both in more detail.

faqs.q: Can I see a sample before ordering?
faqs.a: Yes. Message Pak Clay on WhatsApp at +92 300 4617715 with "Flat Rectangular Khaprail" and your city, or visit the Lahore showroom on Walton Road or the Islamabad location at G-04 Civic Center, Gulberg Greens, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm.
